info.name: FlipTop API
info.description:
Local catalogue API for FlipTop battle transcripts and companion highlights.

Companion (watch overlay): Get battle → Get transcript → Get mentions.
Ops is for filling and curating the catalogue — do not call it from the watch page.

Import this file in Postman (Import → file). Set `videoId` to a battle you have already ingested. Start the server: `uvicorn app.main:app --reload`

item.name: Companion
item.description: The watch-page contract. The extension already has the YouTube video id. Call these GETs once per video; filter mentions by currentTime in the client.

request.description:
Companion entry point. Metadata only (title, status, source, duration) — no segments.

200 + status=ready → fetch transcript and mentions.
200 + pending/processing → still ingesting; do not overlay yet.
404 → not in the catalogue. Show nothing; do not ingest from the watch page.

Timestamped lines for the overlay. `format` is json (default), srt, vtt, or text. JSON includes battle metadata plus segments with idx, start, end, and text.

Sync captions to the player with start/end vs currentTime.
404 if never ingested. 409 if the row exists but has no segments yet.
This route never transcribes.

All highlight marks for the battle (rejected ones omitted).
Load once with the transcript. Each mention has start/end for the playhead, char_start/char_end + alias to underline, and a nested entry (name, kind).

Empty list means annotated but nothing in the glossary hit.
404 if the battle is not ingested.

Same as Get mentions, filtered to marks whose [start, end] covers `at` (seconds). Duplicate names from overlapping segments collapse to one entry.

Useful for debugging a specific second. The companion should filter the full list in memory instead of calling this on every tick.

item.name: Catalogue
item.description: Browse what is already stored. Not used on the watch tick.

request.description:
Paginated catalogue, newest ingest first (not YouTube upload date).
Body is a JSON array. The unpaginated total is in the X-Total-Count header.

Filters: status (pending|processing|ready|failed), source (youtube_auto, whisper_groq, …), channel (substring).

Every named entry the matcher knows (person, event, place). No aliases in the payload.
Optional for a companion legend — each mention already embeds its entry.

item.name: Ops
item.description: Fill and curate the catalogue. Ingest talks to YouTube and can run Whisper.

request.description: Process liveness. Returns {"status":"ok"}. Does not check Groq, yt-dlp, or disk.

Lists YouTube caption tracks without writing the database.
`would_use` is the track ingest would pick (manual over auto, fil/tl/en).

Use this before spending Groq quota: if would_use is set, default ingest takes captions and never calls Whisper. 400 on a bad id, 502 if yt-dlp fails.

Explicit catalogue write. Tiers: manual captions → auto captions → Whisper if allow_whisper and no captions. Does not force Whisper (use scripts/ingest.py --whisper for that).

wait=true blocks until done. wait=false queues an in-process task that dies if the server restarts. force=true replaces an already-ready battle.
400 bad URL, 502 ingest failed.

Set a mention to detected, confirmed, or rejected.
Re-running annotate keeps confirmed and rejected; only detected hits refresh.

Copy a mention id from Get mentions into the mentionId collection variable.
Use "rejected" for false positives. 404 if that id does not exist.

Removes the battle, its segments, and its mentions. Glossary entries stay.
404 if it was never ingested. Check videoId before sending.
